audit.why: Aatrox owns levels 1-5 (Darkin Blade sweetspot knockups plus Deathbringer Stance healing against an Akali with no shroud until W is ranked); Akali takes 6 and the 2-item window against a no-MR bruiser. The level chart and the mirror file aatrox__akali.json agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Level 6 phase text were generic ("Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves", "Reassess every all-in at 6") and named no cooldown.
audit.why: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 out of a 200 pool — that is one Q per trade, which is the real level-1 constraint. Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1; Infernal Chains is 20s at rank 1, so the all-in window is defined by his W, not by 'reassessing'.
audit.corrected: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 and opens out of shroud — go only with Infernal Chains (20s) down, or his drain outlives it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions only said "Shroud-dodge them" and never stated the decisive interaction: what Twilight Shroud does and does not stop.
audit.why: Riot's text for Twilight Shroud: inside it Akali is invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Infernal Chains hits the first enemy hit and World Ender is a self-buff that reveals stealth — neither can pick her out of the smoke. The Darkin Blade is a ground slam with an area of effect, so it lands on her regardless. That is the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Inside Twilight Shroud his W and R cannot select you — The Darkin Blade is a ground slam and still lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item phase named Lich Bane only; the anti-heal timing that actually decides extended trades was absent from the level chart.
audit.why: _missing/akali.json flags Aatrox as sustaining through chip damage via Deathbringer Stance (P), Umbral Dash (E) and World Ender (R). Grievous Wounds timing, not Lich Bane, is what makes the burst stick.
audit.corrected: Lich Bane spikes you, but Grievous Wounds beats his drain — buy Oblivion Orb before you force fights.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — one Q per trade, so spend it after he commits The Darkin Blade.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 and opens out of shroud — go only with Infernal Chains (20s) down, or his drain outlives it.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on The Darkin Blade's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane spikes you, but Grievous Wounds beats his drain — buy Oblivion Orb before you force fights.

edits.before: Track Aatrox's The Darkin Blade: Sweetspots knock up. Shroud-dodge them. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Inside Twilight Shroud his W and R cannot select you — The Darkin Blade is a ground slam and still lands.

notes: Kit-flag misfire: Aatrox's Infernal Chains carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's description says only that champions are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the impact area. Do not write that his W grounds Akali's E or R — unverified. The packet's four suspectNames for this matchup are all false positives (Darkin Blade, Twilight Shroud, Perfect Execution, Infernal Chains are the real names). Content layer for this matchup is already rewritten to bar quality; no content edits needed.
